title: EcoCard: Exceptions and Exclusions
summary: EcoCard’s higher sustainability points rate ($5.00 points per dollar) does not apply to Target, Walmart, Amazon, or ThredUp; purchases with these merchants earn the standard $1.00 point per dollar in-store, online, app, pickup, and delivery. EV charging only earns the higher rate when done on Tesla Supercharger, ChargePoint, or EVgo; other networks qualify for the standard rate.
